name: Pharmacology and Physiology PhD
detailsNote: Summer 2027 application term explicitly confirmed. Admission model not established by the opened sources.

deadlines.label: Early consideration
deadlines.note: Early interviews and decisions in the explicitly Summer 2027 application cycle.

applicationFee.note: International $70; domestic $65. Automatic waiver only for current or former US armed-forces service; overseas applicants must confirm qualification.

english.note: PTE 54 also accepted. Central exemption requests can require proof the entire university teaches exclusively in English; see source policy.

documents: After accepting enrollment: foreign bachelor’s degree requires a general/document-by-document NACES evaluation sent directly by the evaluator before the first term; US bachelor’s degrees exempt
requirements.note: Merged former Molecular, Cellular and Biochemical Pharmacology and Systems Biology and Physiology programs. Accredited bachelor, strong sciences and GPA at least 3.0, emphasizing advanced science work; deficiencies may need remediation. Select Summer 2027 only. Statement covers preparation, research, motivation and goals. Interviews when possible; rolling offers.

funding.note: Domestic and international students receive instructional, general and campus-life fee remission. Good-standing students receive tuition, health and stipend up to five full-time years or the minimum 90-credit threshold; afterward advisor/committee discretion. Current annual stipend $37,132, rising to $38,250 on July 1, 2027.
